quotes.author: Craig
quotes.text: Lowest price we found. Dennis got us on fish, showed us how he reads the sonar, and gave us the full Okanagan tour. Great experience start to finish.

quotes.author: Aaron E.
quotes.text: What an amazing experience I had with Dennis. The boat and gear are all top notch and the lake is a beautiful one. Definitely recommend.

quotes.author: Jason
quotes.text: Amazing day out on the lake! Dennis is a great guy and very knowledgable. Highly recommend!

quotes.author: Aaron E., Google
quotes.text: One of the best fishing experiences we've had. Dennis knows Okanagan Lake inside out, found us the fish, and the boat is super comfortable, even for the kids.

quotes.author: Hayley M., Google
quotes.text: Caught my first kokanee with Dennis. Patient with the kids, honest about conditions, and the rods were set up perfectly. We'll be back next summer.
I've had some awesome times with Dennis and his rentals. I highly recommend his services to anyone looking for a lake adventure.
